# SleepClaw · sleep analysis

Report revision: 1 · 2026-09-20T23:16:21.774Z

This sleep has 420 recorded sleep minutes. Consider your recovery and data coverage before judging overall sleep quality.

## Analysis basis

Record source: Apple Watch (demo)
Scope: Main sleep
Start: 2026-09-20T15:15:00.000Z
End: 2026-09-20T22:45:00.000Z

## Score

Not scored. Scoring rules have not yet been validated.

## Five dimensions

- **duration**：Recorded sleep duration: 420 minutes (device estimate).
- **continuity**：The device recorded 30 awake minutes in the selected interval. Missing intervals are not counted as wake.
- **structure**：Device-estimated stages are available. These records do not establish a medical diagnosis.
- **regularity**：Long-term regularity has not been calculated in this phase.
- **recovery**：Your reported recovery: I woke feeling tired and unrefreshed.
